reminders.title: Get back to Tony on the garage circuit
reminders.description: Tony Marchetti quoted $640 for a dedicated 20 amp run to the garage, permit included, and the price holds 30 days. Told him I'd answer by the end of the month.

reminders.title: Hiscox GL renews 6/3, check the details
reminders.description: Policy UDC-6083147-CGL-25 renews on its own June 3, limits and $38 a month unchanged. If the address, revenue or type of work changed, update the Hiscox account before the 3rd.

reminders.description: 1040-ES #2 for 2026. $2,150 through IRS Direct Pay from business checking 8803, keep the confirmation email.

reminders.title: Pick up the dehumidifier, Home Depot Southfield
reminders.description: Order W948372615 at the Service Desk, held until June 23. Bring the order number and a photo ID.

reminders.title: Last day of school, pick-up at 12:15
reminders.description: Greenlawn half day, dismissal at 12:15 instead of 3:15. Lost and found is out on the tables by the front office until then.

reminders.title: Cherry Republic for Ama
reminders.description: Promised her cherry stuff from up north. Glen Arbor shop, holiday Saturday.

reminders.description: Same as last time: 24x18x12 outers, 20x14x8 inners, 1/2 in foam roll, plus a case of tape. Ama is down to 3 outers and 2 inners. Ask for side-door delivery at the garage.

reminders.description: Ray's tip, the preview pics show a Marantz in a wood case. Opens at 9, runs Sat and Sun. Work it into the morning loop.

reminders.description: Prairie St block party 3 to 8, street closes at 2. A pair of speakers for the music and a chair. Efua has the jollof.

reminders.description: windycityrecordfair.com/vendors/pay, on the business Visa. Told Rosa it would be paid this week.

reminders.description: 4 boxes of Crayola 24s, 24 pencils, 12 glue sticks, 2 pink erasers, blunt scissors, red and blue pocket folders, wide-ruled comp book, over-ear headphones in a Ziploc with his name, tissues, wipes, gallon Ziplocs. New backpack, no wheels, no lights.

reminders.description: Ama entered batches 1 to 3 (1066 to 1128) by copying the closest row. Go through finish and grade tags against the masters and grading guide v3. Prices stay as they are.

reminders.title: Sunday: load the table, chairs and speaker
reminders.description: Labor Day cookout at Auntie Abena's in Southfield, we eat at 1. The folding table, six chairs and the small powered speaker (the good amps stay home). Leave by 4:30 for the Monday ride.

reminders.title: Q3 estimated tax, pay by 9/15
reminders.description: 1040-ES #3 for 2026. $2,150 via Direct Pay out of 8803, same as June.

reminders.title: Furnace tune-up, stay in the house 9 to 11
reminders.description: Six Mile Heating & Cooling, confirmation SMH-48217. Tech calls my cell about 30 minutes ahead. Three feet clear around the furnace, no UPS runs till they're done.

reminders.description: Marantz 2230 (CAW-1124) goes out today, UPS Ground, double-boxed. Post the tracking number in his Messenger thread as soon as the Pirate Ship label prints.

reminders.description: Reliability, photo and lighting skills, and two example shoots with SKUs and dates: the August haul masters and the Aug 12 Bench Notes recap. Mention she built the raking-light setup herself.

reminders.title: Napkins and cups in Kwame's backpack
reminders.description: For the class Halloween party Friday after the parade. Efua told the room parent we'd send them in Thursday.

reminders.title: Answer Derek, Thu 10-29
reminders.description: Marantz 2230 (CAW-1124). Go through his three photos against listing photo 5 and Ama's pre-ship set, then reply in Messenger.

reminders.title: Kwame's red homework folder back to school
reminders.description: Comes home every Monday and has to go back by Friday. Go through it with him, then into the backpack.

reminders.title: Robot costume to school in a labeled bag
reminders.description: Halloween parade this afternoon on the blacktop. Costume goes in a bag with his name, he changes after lunch. Face stays open, battery cover screwed shut, he gets in and out by himself.

reminders.title: Cash for Walt, Fri 10/30
reminders.description: Small bills. MCCU branch on Livernois.

reminders.title: Parent-teacher conference sign-up, by Fri 10/30
reminders.description: Greenlawn, 15 minutes with Kwame's teacher, in person or by phone. Pick a slot in ParentSquare after checking Efua's schedule.

reminders.description: $1,250 from personal checking 8851 on the 1st. The other half goes on the 15th.

reminders.description: Email body is fine, about a page. Dates for the two example shoots. priya@lumenstudiodetroit.com

reminders.description: Ama shoots on her Tuesday shift, I write the caption and post at 12. Next up is knob pullers, not screwdrivers. Long version of the dim-bulb tip for Walt after that.

reminders.description: Eastern Market Print job EMP-4418, 500 cards. Deposit of $71.25 went in 9/28, the other $71.25 is due when they deliver Thu 11/5. The slot is only held through Fri 10/30.
